## Description

A planktonic centric diatom: a disc of ~15 µm, non-motile. Very efficient at low silica: it beats
*Asterionella* when Si limits (Tilman 1977).

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 20 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

Disc-shaped frustule (in girdle view the axis is half the diameter). P and Si limited with the
constants of Tilman and Kilham. Host of chytrids.

## Literature

- Tilman D. (1977) Ecology 58: 338–348.
- Tilman D., Kilham S.S. (1976) J. Phycol. 12: 375–383 (µmax and K, **not verified**).

## Not implemented yet

- Valve view vs girdle view are not both available; the frustule ornamentation is not drawn.
- No auxospore formation (size restoration).

## Unique and shared mechanics

Competes with *Asterionella* in the validated [Tilman experiment](../../mechanics/well-mixed-culture.md);
shares the [frustule and Si limitation](../../mechanics/metabolism-and-nutrients.md) with the other diatoms.
